description: This file defines the CustomerOptionSetDao interface, which provides data access methods for CustomerOptionSet entities, including retrieval by various attributes such as option ID, store, and language.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetDao
classes.description: An interface extending SalesManagerEntityDao, providing methods to access CustomerOptionSet entities based on various parameters.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a given MerchantStore and option ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet entities for a specific MerchantStore and Language combination.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionSet by its unique ID.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a given MerchantStore and option value ID.
